title: Automatic directory indexing must be disabled.
check_content:
Enter the following command:

/usr/local/Apache2.2/bin/httpd –M.

This will provide a list of all loaded modules. If autoindex_module is found, this is a finding.
fixtext: Edit the httpd.conf file and remove autoindex_module.
VulnDiscussion: To identify the type of web servers and versions software installed it is common for attackers to scan for icons or special content specific to the server type and version. A simple request like http://example.com/icons/apache_pb2.png may tell the attacker that the server is Apache 2.2 as shown below. The many icons are used primary for auto indexing, which is recommended to be disabled.
